dedupe_keys.name: simulated ultrasonic pulse echo well integrity data and comsol setups

description: SINTEF Digital and NTNU publish simulated ultrasonic pulse-echo measurements for oil and gas well integrity analysis. The deposit covers pipe and plate geometries with varied wall thickness, diameter, material properties, bonding and transducer alignment. COMSOL simulations use a 250-kHz pulse and provide raw pressure traces, averaged JSON waveforms, ground-truth parameters and two model setups in MPH format. The public Mendeley Data release is free under CC BY 4.0. These observations can calibrate diagnostic algorithms and validate acoustic components of infrastructure-condition simulations; model-openfoam offers a related physical-modelling environment without a verified direct interface. A caveat is that numerical ground truth reflects the assumed geometry and materials, not field defects. Re-running the MPH setups requires COMSOL and compatible modules. The public file list was inspected without downloading data or models.
